verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents first-class workflow automation ('Trigger workflow: Easily create and trigger unique business workflows to notify, update, or validate information'). It also mentions workflow Blueprints and bulk collection reminders, and bank feeds import automatically. However, none of the evidence says these workflows can run on a time-based or recurring schedule, so the scheduling core of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit time-based or recurring scheduling of workflows/jobs, documentation of schedule configuration (frequency, cron-like rules), API or MCP control of schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
